title: the rendered launch line passes --worktree path:<primary>, and the dispatch guard allows exactly that line
source: intended: docs/decisions.md A2 (defect N-23): the dispatcher names the primary worktree on its launch line
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect N-23, owner answer A2). The fixture prompt template ends its launch line with --worktree {{WORKTREE}}, and the dispatcher renders {{WORKTREE}} as path:<primary worktree of the project>, so the worker's terminal is opened in the project instead of wherever Orca falls back to. The dispatch guard allows exactly that line when JITSO_PROJECT names the project. The TS binary leaves {{WORKTREE}} literal in the prompt, and its guard denies --build, so the regex and the allow decision FAIL on TS.
